body:
## What it does

Reads your recent X activity to work out what you actually care about, confirms the beat with you, and then flags what is happening in it rather than in general. It runs on a schedule rather than waiting to be asked.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @daniel_mac8 shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
